purpose: Turn economic discovery into a repeatable experimental discipline that can discover, test, verify and replicate commercial mechanisms across independent commerce cells.
primary_objective: Improve the economic reality of Biggie and Peggy first; pursue world-scale economic leverage as a consequence of mechanisms that actually work.

mechanism_definition.replication_rule: Copy the mechanism and its boundary conditions, not merely the product or brand.

factory_factory.role: Generate bounded commerce experiments from observed demand and known capabilities, then learn from verified outcomes and generate controlled replications.
factory_factory.promotion_rule: Autonomy may increase only after measured successful outcomes and preserved human authority boundaries.

current_state_2026_09_25.note: Infrastructure is extensive; the binding economic gap remains conversion of verified demand into an independently proven external transaction and then a repeatable mechanism.

first_money_gate.success_condition: one external buyer completes a settled purchase, supplies required input, receives the promised fulfillment, and the complete event is independently reconciled.

portfolio_strategy.principle: One truth-gated economic substrate, many independent commerce cells.

implementation_rule: Prefer direct, testable changes to GitHub, Supabase, Stripe and deployment configuration over strategy documents. Never fabricate revenue, buyers, credentials, outreach or proof.
